findings.evidence: _compose_value ends with `return _scalar(block or text, key)`: when neither the mcp service block nor the shared anchor block exists, the whole deploy/compose.yaml is scanned, so a services-only file without an mcp service attributes a sibling's environment scalar (e.g. metrics' GRAPH_PROJECTOR_ENAB
findings.title: Compose fallback can measure another service's value

findings.evidence: For code_symbol, `ref.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]` yields "" for refs like "Server.", which is not in identifiers, so present=False and a malformed ref emits a CONTRADICTS 'absent' code observation for an exists claim instead of being dropped like refs "." and "/"; question to check whether malformed refs sh
findings.title: Trailing-dot symbol ref measures 'absent' instead of being dropped

findings.evidence: `_scalar(_block(text, "deploy") or text, "site")` reads any `site:` key when no deploy block exists, so a `site:` under an unrelated block would be measured; impact is limited by the domain filter to the three pinned host values.
findings.title: Host measurement falls back to the whole rail.yaml

findings.evidence: _embedding returns the named EMBEDDING_BACKEND scalar before consulting EMBEDDING_SERVICE_URL, so a contradictory pair (backend mistral-api with a shim URL) reconciles to the backend value rather than unmeasurable; a priority trade-off, but if the intent is competing-evidence-drops-out as in _ci_sys
findings.title: Embedding backend silently overrides a conflicting URL
